        alignment=json.loads(alignment_raw)
        require(alignment['state']=='SOURCE_ONLY_LOCK_ALIGNMENT_NOT_COMPILED_OR_SOONG_QUALIFIED' and
                alignment['baseline']['manifest']['sha256']==MANIFEST_PARENT and
                alignment['baseline']['compile_result']['sha256']==parent_pin['sha256'] and
                alignment['candidate']['manifest']['sha256']==MANIFEST_470 and
                alignment['candidate']['source_delta']==FIXED_PROVIDER_DELTA and
                alignment['candidate']['source_files']==499 and alignment['candidate']['unchanged']==497 and
                alignment['candidate']['changed_existing']==2 and alignment['candidate']['added']==0 and
                alignment['source_locks']['project_count']==225 and alignment['source_locks']['root_links']==8 and
                alignment['strictness']['ALLOW_MISSING_DEPENDENCIES']=='false' and
                alignment['strictness']['targets']==['framework-minus-apex','libandroid_runtime'] and
                alignment['history']['source_lock_writer']=='UNKNOWN' and
                alignment['validation']['host_compile_performed'] is False,
                'fixed lock-alignment derivation does not bind this candidate')
        lock_name='android/manifest/m2-role-ingress-hal-provider-source-lock.json'
        previous_lock_raw,previous_lock_pin=held(COPIED/lock_name)
        current_lock_raw,current_lock_pin=pinned_packet('delta/'+lock_name,copied_expected[lock_name]['sha256'])
        require(previous_lock_pin['sha256']==expected[lock_name]['sha256']==alignment['source_locks']['historical']['sha256'] and
                previous_lock_pin['bytes']==expected[lock_name]['bytes']==96934 and
                current_lock_pin['sha256']==alignment['source_locks']['candidate']['sha256'] and
                current_lock_pin['bytes']==copied_expected[lock_name]['bytes']==96957,
                'exact old/current lock bytes differ from the bound source maps')
        previous_lock=json.loads(previous_lock_raw);current_lock=json.loads(current_lock_raw)
        field_changes=alignment['exact_lock_field_changes']
        require([(row['path'],row['project']) for row in field_changes]==[
                    ('/projects/221/sparse_paths','packages/services/Car'),
                    ('/projects/224/purpose','packages/modules/NeuralNetworks'),
                    ('/projects/224/sparse_paths','packages/modules/NeuralNetworks')],
                'lock alignment is not exactly the three reviewed fields')
        for row in field_changes:
            _,parent_name,index,field=row['path'].split('/')
            require(parent_name=='projects','non-project lock field changed')
            project=previous_lock['projects'][int(index)]
            require(project['path']==row['project'] and project[field]==row['before'],
                    'historical lock field does not equal the exact reviewed value')
            if field=='sparse_paths':
                require(len(set(row['before']))==len(row['before']) and len(set(row['after']))==len(row['after']) and
                        sorted(row['before'])==sorted(row['after']),
                        'lock alignment changed the selected source path set')
            project[field]=row['after']
        require(previous_lock==current_lock and len(current_lock['projects'])==225 and len(current_lock['links'])==8,
                'other source-lock field, project, URL, commit or selection changed')
        observed_raw,observed_pin=pinned_packet('observed-published225-manifest.json',
            '5ae96f8d2bc32986fdbf8fea12f54dbcb02b1ed1601894b2b23998f61aba0d7d')
        require(observed_pin['bytes']==109252 and
                alignment['observed_materialized_manifest']['sha256']==observed_pin['sha256'],
                'fixed observed materialized manifest bytes differ')
        # Exact serialization of the already observed plan, not a fresh checkout qualification.
        # The unchanged droidloom-source verifier/prepare/reconcile remains the real build gate.
        projected_projects=[]
        for project in current_lock['projects']:
            projected={'path':project['path'],'url':current_lock['remote_base']+project['name'],
                       'commit':project['commit'],'purpose':project['purpose']}
            if project.get('sparse_paths'):
                projected['sparse_paths']=project['sparse_paths']
            projected_projects.append(projected)
        projected_plan={'schema_version':1,'superproject_commit':current_lock['superproject']['commit'],
                        'projects':projected_projects,'links':current_lock['links'],'unrestricted_repo_sync':False}
        rebuilt={'schema_version':1,'source_lock_sha256':sha(current_lock_raw),'plan':projected_plan}
        require(json.dumps(rebuilt,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')==observed_raw,
                'current exact lock does not reconstruct the complete observed manifest')
        report['lock_alignment_derivation_authority']=alignment_pin
        report['observed_materialized_manifest_authority']=observed_pin
        report['historical_lock_authority']=previous_lock_pin
        report['observed_manifest_rebuilt_exactly']=True
        report['source_lock_writer']='UNKNOWN'
        changes=[name for name in copied_expected if copied_expected[name]!=expected.get(name)]
        wanted=FIXED_PROVIDER_DELTA
        require(sorted(changes)==wanted and set(expected)==set(copied_expected) and
                sum(name not in expected for name in changes)==0 and
                sum(name in expected for name in changes)==2 and
                all(copied_expected[name]==expected[name] for name in expected if name not in wanted),
                'lock alignment delta is not exactly two replacements and no additions')
